reasoning_effort.rationale: levels low/high/max; API default max (README L627). CRITICAL: the encoder keyword is `thinking_effort`, not `reasoning_effort` (L618-633). If `thinking_effort` is absent the encoder injects NO effort message, so a backend that forwards `reasoning_effort` as a template kwarg would silently drop it. The study passes thinking_effort='max' to the encoder and verifies the rendered 'thinking-effort' internal system message. Note: that message text lists low/medium/high/max while the validator accepts only low/high/max (L21 vs L630) - a publisher inconsistency, irrelevant for 'max'.
reasoning_effort.hosted_note: hosted API parameter reasoning_effort=max (API default max); the encoder keyword thinking_effort applies only to self-hosting
